title: Once-Daily Lot Clock versus Per-Admission Risk Clock

research_height.transfer_path: The first/second/later admission sequence and its pre-order floating state determine conservative capital and planned risk at each decision; the day-fixed lot state then transmits any clock mismatch through stop incidence and stressed lifecycle return to shared capital.

central_question: Does the once-daily lot multiplier materially lag the per-admission conservative risk-capital clock inside a server day, so that later decisions after adverse floating state receive narrower risk geometry without a corresponding lot reset and then realize worse stop or stressed-R outcomes?

research_bundle.name: durable_attempt_clock_reconstruction_ordinal_contrast_and_outcome_transmission
lenses: mechanism: reconstruct exact risk capital from planned_risk/0.04 at the durable pre-broker ORDER_ATTEMPTED snapshot and compare current versus hypothetical lot multiplier
natural contrast: compare first versus later same-day decisions and later negative-floating versus nonnegative-floating states without selecting a component or clock time
transmission and falsification: compare filled lifecycle stop incidence and stressed R, with CP2 period breadth and an independent compounded binding-journal cohort

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 066 preserved the stop-defined tail-risk contract but showed that realized losses feed capital through many native exits as well as rare stops. The unresolved next step is whether those intraday equity and realized states alter the risk geometry of later orders while the lot multiplier remains frozen until the next server day.
why_now.connection_bridge: The authoritative source updates day_volume_multiplier only when ServerMidnight changes, but ConservativeRiskCapital takes the minimum of project-stage balance, account balance, account equity and stressed balance at every admission. The immutable event ledger records a durable pre-broker equity/stage/stressed snapshot for each ORDER_ATTEMPTED and later records planned risk.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 066 was Program 4 micro liquidation-channel attribution. Unit 067 moves to Program 3 meso intraday state transition at the next admission, with order chronology and two clock resolutions as the causal mechanism rather than exit class.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain one later separately declared isolated Lab candidate that aligns lot and risk clock semantics while preserving signals, times, holds and risk fractions. Do not implement or promote automatically.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve once-daily sizing and per-admission conservative risk exactly; close without ordinal, floating-state, time or threshold rescue.
why_now.decision_if_partial: Record a clock-state observation only and retain no candidate if risk geometry changes without stale lot state or if no adverse outcome transmission appears.

immutable_source_contract.lot_clock: At the first tick of a new ServerMidnight day, multiplier = 1 + floor(max(0, stressed_balance - 100)/150); it remains fixed until the next server day.
immutable_source_contract.risk_clock: At every admission, conservative capital is min(project-stage balance, account balance, account equity, stressed balance); planned risk is conservative capital times 0.04.
immutable_source_contract.event_snapshot: ORDER_ATTEMPTED is persisted immediately before the synchronous broker call and RecordEvent captures stressed balance, project-stage balance and account equity at that moment.

immutable_binding_journal_inputs.role: Independent compounded high-capital cohort for clock-state confirmation, not a full binding-run rank or component attribution.

frozen_reconstruction.ordering: Within each independent period/cohort, sort by server time, numeric state_sequence and stable source-file/source-row order; preserve all distinct rows.
frozen_reconstruction.attempt_pairing: Each ORDER_ATTEMPTED opens one component-local pending decision and must pair to the next market OPEN or PASSIVE_PLACE for that component. CP2 permits zero unmatched rows. Binding permits exactly one birth without an attempt from the declared recovery and excludes only that admission/lifecycle from attempt-state metrics.
frozen_reconstruction.planned_risk: Market planned risk comes from OPEN detail; Passive planned risk comes from PASSIVE_PLACE detail. Derived risk capital is planned_risk/0.04.
frozen_reconstruction.pre_order_state: Use the matched ORDER_ATTEMPTED row's stressed_balance, project_stage_balance and account_equity. Floating state is account_equity minus project_stage_balance: NEGATIVE below -0.02 USD, FLAT within +/-0.02, POSITIVE above +0.02.
frozen_reconstruction.observed_minimum: min(project_stage_balance, stressed_balance, account_equity). At least 99% of decisions must match derived risk capital within 0.03 USD; otherwise invalidate because unobserved account balance may be binding.
frozen_reconstruction.size_state: Carry forward the most recent SIZE_DAY value_b multiplier in the same cohort. Hypothetical current multiplier is 1+floor(max(0, attempt stressed_balance-100)/150). Exclude attempts before the first retained SIZE_DAY only from multiplier metrics.
frozen_reconstruction.ordinal: Group admissions by server date and chronological attempt order as FIRST, SECOND, or THIRD_PLUS. Later means SECOND or THIRD_PLUS. Normalize each decision's risk capital by that day's FIRST decision risk capital.
frozen_reconstruction.lifecycle: Market OPEN and filled Passive PLACE pair to CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE. Passive expiry has no outcome. Stressed R is close value_b divided by admission planned risk; stop is reason DEAL_REASON_SL.

requirements: At least 400 CP2 and 100 binding matched later decisions exist, and each cohort has at least 30 later NEGATIVE and 30 later nonnegative floating-state decisions.
Definite equity binding occurs in at least 0.10 of later decisions in both CP2 and binding cohorts.
Median absolute deviation of later risk capital from that day's FIRST risk capital is at least 0.02 in both cohorts.
In the binding cohort, current versus hypothetical multiplier differs on at least 0.05 of multiplier-eligible later decisions and at least 10 decisions.
Later NEGATIVE-state median risk-capital ratio is at least 0.02 below later nonnegative-state median in both cohorts.
Among filled later decisions, NEGATIVE minus nonnegative stressed-R mean is at most -0.10 or stop-rate difference is at least +0.05 in both CP2 and binding cohorts.
The same adverse metric and sign passes in at least three of four CP2 periods.
No one component contributes more than 0.60 of CP2 NEGATIVE filled later decisions.

fixed_verdict_rules.complete: PASS_MATERIAL_INTRADAY_SIZING_RISK_CLOCK_RATCHET when integrity, the complete mechanism gate and the complete transmission gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.mechanism_only: PARTIAL_CLOCK_DIVERGENCE_WITHOUT_ADVERSE_TRANSMISSION_NO_CANDIDATE when the mechanism gate passes but transmission fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_material: NO_MATERIAL_INTRADAY_CLOCK_RATCHET_PRESERVE_DAILY_SIZING when the mechanism gate fails and integrity passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_INTRADAY_CLOCK_STATE_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any source/input, event, pairing, minimum-capital, size-state, lifecycle or numerical integrity condition fails.

decision_translation.complete: Retain one later isolated Lab candidate for clock alignment, with exact unchanged signals, sessions, holds, risk fractions and all six components. Do not open it automatically.
decision_translation.mechanism_only: Record the clock divergence as non-adverse and retain no candidate.
decision_translation.no_material: Preserve once-daily lot sizing and per-admission conservative risk without reinterpretation.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away after budget exhaustion.

stop_rules: Commit and push declaration, state and Frontier memory before calculating any binding-source share, within-day risk ratio, multiplier divergence or outcome metric.
One implementation-only correction is allowed only if aggregation stops before emitting any clock, state, ordinal or outcome metric. After any such metric is emitted, make no correction or rerun.
Do not change the 0.02 USD floating-state boundary, 0.03 USD identity tolerance, ordinal groups, 2/5/10-percent gates or any outcome threshold.
Do not select a component, time, period, direction, winner/loser subset or alternate day boundary, and do not create MQL, run Tester, query broker/account state or touch Live.
